ledger_accounts_kind_owner_check.name: ledger_accounts_kind_owner_check
ledger_accounts_kind_owner_check.value:
("ledger_accounts"."kind" in ('client_wallet', 'client_hold') and "ledger_accounts"."owner_type" is not distinct from 'client')
 or ("ledger_accounts"."kind" = 'supplier_prepaid' and "ledger_accounts"."owner_type" is not distinct from 'supplier')
 or ("ledger_accounts"."kind" not in ('client_wallet', 'client_hold', 'supplier_prepaid') and "ledger_accounts"."owner_type" is null)

pricing_rules_window_check.name: pricing_rules_window_check
pricing_rules_window_check.value: "pricing_rules"."ends_at" is null or "pricing_rules"."starts_at" is null or "pricing_rules"."ends_at" > "pricing_rules"."starts_at"

refunds_storefront_refs_check.name: refunds_storefront_refs_check
refunds_storefront_refs_check.value: "refunds"."customer_id" is null or ("refunds"."payment_id" is not null and "refunds"."order_id" is not null)
